w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: It's settled. The village is calling it "Old Gavel." The Codex keeps it.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — Chorus Line. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE TERMS OF SERVICE! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💀 The Ad Break killed Marta in 6 rounds. The village mourns.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "The audience is bored of the rerun. Do something they haven’t seen."
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "That's not an honor. It's just what the aliens like to see. You're going on television."
📺 SYSTEM: "Give the cameras a moment they'll replay FOREVER!! — Pip!"
📺 SYSTEM: "The audience is bored of the rerun. Do something they haven’t seen."
📺 SYSTEM: "● LIVE — Shelter Swap. YOU is on television."

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: The humming gets louder. It's coming toward the sound of you.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
